question: Do the inherited classes and the transporter exhaust the global image in the strict/relaxed local-condition quotient, without determining the anchor Selmer group?
prior_diagnostic: Existing local signatures show that anchor classes span each anchor local point image and eta belongs locally to the sum of the two point images. This is a retrospective theorem verification, not a blind prediction.
checks: Certify the anchor local point image by containment of global anchor points and equality with the independently known local dimension.
Form each local intersection C=L0 intersect Lu and sum D=L0+Lu, including the real place.
Verify eta lies in every D, and form the direct-sum boundary of all 21 global classes modulo C.
Require the global boundary rank to equal half the local quotient dimension; reciprocity and local duality then prove completeness of this boundary.
Compute intersections with both local point structures and derive only relative full Selmer dimensions and exact new-prime ramification dimensions.
failure_semantics: If the boundary does not reach half dimension, full boundary completeness remains UNKNOWN. The anchor Selmer dimension and all absolute curve-rank upper bounds remain UNKNOWN.
